title: Burst the Bubble
instruction: This is your video feed. Each day, open the one item you'd watch. Watch the topic count.
instruction2: Get your feed back to 5 or more topics within 5 days. Open something different, search a topic, tap 'Not interested', or switch on the platform's exploration setting.
reveal: The narrowing happened without anyone deciding it: each click nudged the profile, and the feed is sampled from the profile. From inside, nothing looks missing. That is why a filter bubble is invisible.
reveal2: Opening something different moves your profile slowly. 'Not interested' and the platform's exploration slots move it fastest, and exploration also shows you topics you could not have asked for.
debrief: A filter bubble forms from ordinary clicks feeding back into the feed, and it is invisible because you cannot see what is withheld. Deliberate variety and exploration slots are how it is burst.
